name: message
description: One turn in a conversation: who said it and what was said. Render inside a list so the conversation has structure.

role.description: error is a system notice, such as a failed model call.

content.description: Plain text. Blank lines start a new paragraph.

author.description: Display name. Defaults to You, Assistant, or System by role.

id.description: Anchor id so the page can link to the latest message.

wcag.notes: Author is text, not colour or alignment alone (1.4.1). Each message is an article with its author as a heading so screen readers can move between turns.

machine.identify: Read data-role for who spoke and the article text for the content.
